page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.large is an entry-level instance belonging to the ecs.sn1ne family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 2 vCPUs mapped to a single physical core of an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance features dedicated CPU allocation and supports hyper-threading. It is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB. The CPU architecture is x86_64, supporting instruction set extensions such as AVX, AVX512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core metric is weak, falling in the bottom 25%, while the multi-core score drops to the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show poor performance, with read-only large block speeds at 10.24 GB/sec and write speeds at 9.37 GB/sec. Geekbench and Passmark CPU scores also rank in the bottom 10%, reflecting the older architecture of the underlying Intel Xeon processor. Redis SET operations achieve 1.45 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 1.22 GB/sec.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, this instance represents a low-resource option. It is best suited for lightweight, non-critical workloads such as basic web serving, small-scale development or testing environments, and simple utility scripts that do not require high memory or storage throughput.
